title: Pixel 2 compatibility issues?
symptom: On a Pixel 2, after upgrading xDrip+ from version xDrip-plus-20171006-1a08760.apk to xDrip-plus-20171113-20a4313.apk, it stops collecting data and gets stuck on the 'collecting initial readings' popup after restarting the sensor. The latest version worked on a Nexus 6P.
cause: The problem was that the Dexcom was still paired to the old phone.
fix: Unpair the Dexcom from the old phone. One user succeeded by putting the old phone in airplane mode and then hitting 'Forget Device' in xDrip's System Status.
evidence_quote: It's working now. The problem was that my Dexcom was still paired to my old my phone.
